jobs.description: A stylized scruffy STRAY DOG enemy facing LEFT in side view, compact chunky tawny-brown torso, BIG blunt angular muzzle and head about one third of its silhouette, one short bent floppy ear, four SHORT THICK block-shaped legs with large squared paws, short thin crooked tail, dark-brown saddle patch. This dog is smaller and lower than the wolf.

poseRequest.description: Change ONLY the pose of this same wild dog to a clearly dazed stunned crouch, still facing RIGHT.
